newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia gov't paper mkt volume 220.26 trln roubles.
newsitem.headline: Russia gov't paper mkt volume 220.26 trln roubles.

text.p: Russia's current government paper volume rose to 220.26 trillion roubles on November 8 from 214.91 trillion roubles on November 1, the central bank said on Sunday.
The market value of government securities rose to 195.76 trillion roubles from 191.10 trillion roubles, it said in a statement.
The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills rose to 167.84 trilion roubles from 164.04 trillion roubles, it said.
The market value of OFZ government bonds rose to 27.93 trillion roubles from 27.06 trillion roubles.
The volume of paper issued but not sold fell to 29.73 trillion roubles from 30.54 trillion roubles.
